issue.title: Readme should be .md instead of .txt
issue.body:
Is there any reason for keeping the readme as .txt file instead of .md?

As far as I can see, the file contains MarkDown syntax for links and I can also see some HTML <a> tags (which i think are interpreted by MD)

Before writing this issue, I checked if there is any special feature on GitHub for .txt files or any recommendation at all about the two.  I couldn't find a recommendation, but I found these threads:
README.txt vs. README.md · Issue #2701 · go-gitea/gitea
https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/issues/2701

Readme.txt vs Readme.md · Issue #2228 · MicrosoftDocs/azure-devops-docs
https://github.com/MicrosoftDocs/azure-devops-docs/issues/2228

I think it would make more sense to keep it as a .md file
